reuse.why: Instead of introducing or using one category-selection function for month-wide actions, the flag is threaded by hand into each of six actions' own filters.

duplication.why: The include-hidden condition is written six times (four identical SQL WHERE clauses plus two JS guards in copyPreviousMonth and setZero), extending the existing copies rather than consolidating them.

placement.why: Changes stay in budget/actions.ts where the actions live, though the hidden-category rule remains scattered across SQL and JS per action.

scope.why: Adds a template-category exclusion to set6MonthAvg (a behaviour change when the flag is absent), plus formatting churn and an unrelated await removal in tests and setLastMonthSpending.

maintainability.why: Any future change to which categories month-wide actions touch must again be edited in six places in two languages, and an unrequested behaviour change is hidden among reformatting.

disguised_duplication.where: The same flag check is pasted openly into each action's SQL or JS filter.
